notes: Sign in to connectors: services that need a sign-in (like Cloudflare) now have a Sign in button under Settings → Connectors. Your browser opens, you press Allow, and the AI can use it. Sign-ins are stored encrypted on this PC and renew by themselves.
Cloudflare in Quick add: your whole account, Workers with KV, R2 and D1, Workers logs, and Cloudflare's docs.

Saved tokens reach the tools that need them: a Cloudflare token saved as CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN now works with wrangler without the AI having to name it. The same goes for gh (GH_TOKEN), Vercel, Netlify, Supabase and Fly.
The AI now knows today's date, your time zone and whether the folder is a Git project.
The AI also reads the notes Claude Code keeps about the same project, so it knows what Claude Code has learned there.
